qualification: The CT is acquired; the radiograph is simulated from an assigned bone-in-water phantom derived from its labels.
Assigned and recovered fractions are not measured patient composition; the CT HU values are display context only.
Fixed poses were supplied. This sequence does not contain a recorded registration-to-reconstruction step.
The historical 1,000-update run reached its iteration budget; convergence and noise-limited recovery are not established.
The vertebral region includes cropped ribs. Recorded surfaces remain unsmoothed and open at cropped boundaries.
NIST source and derived attenuation tables are excluded; this display is not a reproduction using the later xraylib model.
